limitations: An isolated native Android probe, not an Overte fix APK.
All six normal docked-IME window frames remained asymmetric; this is negative investigation evidence, not an issue acceptance PASS.
The camera cutout was on the right in this experiment, unlike the earlier left-cutout Overte baseline.
Build 1 used fullscreen extract mode and was superseded by the docked-mode comparison in build 2.
Build 3 collected an unscoped log-tail sample; it is not used as fresh per-process callback proof.
Build 4 failed while reading the newly started process ID before the process was ready; it is not centering evidence.
